title: Kojic Acid vs Alpha Arbutin: Which Suits Your Skin?
ex: Both help dark spots look less noticeable. Kojic acid has the longer track record; alpha arbutin is gentler and more stable. Here is how to choose.
rt: Kojic Acid vs Alpha Arbutin: Which Suits You? | Mirc Glow
rd: Kojic acid vs alpha arbutin: how each works on dark spots, which suits sensitive skin, whether to use them together, and how to get steady, realistic results.
quick: Kojic acid and alpha arbutin both slow the enzyme skin uses to make pigment, helping dark spots look less noticeable over 8 to 12 weeks. Kojic acid is more widely used but can tingle and darken in the jar; alpha arbutin is usually gentler and more stable. Both need daily sunscreen.
facts: Kojic acid is typically used at about 1–2%
Alpha arbutin is used at up to about 2%
One spot-focused ingredient per night is usually enough
